GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward to lead .5 Lengths 800m lead 1 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden 2nd weakened badly final 300m # led/weak 300m

Began fairly. Pushed fwd before raced 4th Two Wide (3L from lead) early . Held Ground until improving on inside @ 500m. Pushed to quicken on rail @ 400m Chasing 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Two Wide in straight. # Struggled from turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1000m was steadied when crowded for room between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped very well then Restrained and Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , couldn't get in middle stages, moved up to trail 3 Wide by a head turning, steered Wide Straightening Up and Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 2 Lengths 3 Wide turning, dropped off in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 1 length. 2nd turn. battled away # Every Chance

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing 0.75 Lengths , railed up and took Lead at the 1000m, Held Together in front and led 1 length turning (+5 lengths to 3rd), Headed 160m and weakened to the line. [Stewards: An inquiry into the app. jockey's riding/tempo Set  was opened and adjourned.] # weakening 3rd place
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out under pressure over the final 200m. An inquiry into apps riding of the mare, particularly the tempo set in the early and middle stages, was opened and adjourned to a date to be fixed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1.5 lld on fence, Held Together in front & led 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed top of the Straight but kept trying to the line # battled on ok
Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. battled away # Every Chance

Jumped well. Pushed fwd & raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace until improved to join leader 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along =lead Five Wide on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & bumped @ 200m. Faded 3 Wide in last 150m. # On-pace/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide, without cover, in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down on fence trailing 0.75 Lengths , held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, Held Up home turn , went for rails run early in Straight and got blocked/checked at 250m, shifted Two Wide and had clear running from 200m, made a little progress but unlikely it was ever winning the race. [Stewards: Raced keenly rounding first turn and through middle stages.] # Had some excuse
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Commenced to race keenly rounding the first turn and continued throughout the middle stages. Approaching the 200m was steadied when disappointed for a run and obliged to shift out around heels to continue to improve.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 2 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced three wide, without cover, throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Niggled to recover & raced 2nd last Two Wide (4L from lead) early . Stayed same until 3 Wide @ 550m & held up Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & ran on steadily in last 200m. # Good last 200m.
